description: GEO-TREES site name.
Plot name, unique within the site.
ID of the rover geo-reference point
The date of the GNSS measurement. This should ideally be YYYY-MM-DD. YYYY-MM and YYYY are also accepted.
TRUE if the point is a plot corner
X coordinate of the stem map at this point relative to the entire plot (m).
Y coordinate of the stem map at this point relative to the entire plot (m).
UTM Easting coordinate of the rover. If using a handheld GNSS unit, enter the coordinates of the sample point here.
UTM Northing coordinate of the rover. If using a handheld GNSS unit, enter the coordinates of the sample point here.
Elevation (typically orthometric height/above mean sea level) of the rover.
Ellipsoidal height of the rover.
Root Mean Square (RMS) error for the rover's Easting measurement (horizontal precision).
Root Mean Square (RMS) error for the rover's Northing measurement (horizontal precision).
Root Mean Square (RMS) error for the rover's elevation measurement (vertical precision).
Root Mean Square (RMS) error for the rover's overall lateral/horizontal position.
Height of the rover's antenna measured from the ground reference mark.
Start date and time of the rover's data collection/occupation, recorded in UTC.
End date and time of the rover's data collection/occupation, recorded in UTC.
Total number of samples (epochs) recorded by the rover during the occupation.
Model identifier of the rover,  e.g. Emlid Reach RS4+.
Position Dilution of Precision (PDOP) recorded at the rover.
Geometric Dilution of Precision (GDOP) recorded at the rover.
UTM Easting coordinate of the reference base-station used for corrections.
UTM Northing coordinate of the reference base-station.
Elevation (typically orthometric height) of the reference base-station.
Ellipsoidal height of the reference base-station.
Model identifier of the reference base-station,  e.g. Emlid Reach RS4+.
Name of the coordinate reference system, preferably the local WGS84 UTM zone, e.g. 'UTM 18S'.
EPSG code of the coordinate reference system, e.g. 32718 for UTM zone 18S.
Number of satellites used in the solution during geo-referencing.
Mathematical model of the Earth's mean sea level used by the receiver or software to convert raw ellipsoidal heights into standard orthometric elevations. E.g. GEOID18, EGM2008.
Calculation mode of the post-processed rover position. E.g. "PPK Fixed" for highest precision, "PPK Float", "DGPS", "Single/Autonomous", "RTK Fixed", "RTK Float".
